outcome: unrecovered low back pain (LBP) after delivery
cohort: 257 pregnant women who suffered from LBP during pregnancy and registered at obstetrics units in two tertiary hospitals between January 2016 and June 2017.
finding: Low hand grip strength (<25 kg) was the strongest predictor for unrecovered low back pain two years after delivery (adjusted OR = 9.12, P < 0.001).
